scenarios.name: Battle for Caer Renaris — The Key Keep
scenarios.description: Caer Renaris is one of Albion's key keeps in Hadrian's Wall, with only 2 towers. Controlling it is essential for porting access. This scenario simulates a large-scale assault on the keep by Hibernia and/or Midgard forces.
scenarios.map: Hadrian's Wall — Caer Renaris and its surrounding towers

objective.albion: Defend Caer Renaris for 10 rounds. Keep the capture bar from filling.
objective.hibernia: Capture Caer Renaris by filling the capture bar before time runs out.
objective.midgard: Capture Caer Renaris OR let Hibernia weaken Albion, then take it.

special_rules: Capture bar fills when enemies stand in the keep
Towers speed up capture — capturing both towers is critical
Siege towers can bypass walls
Tinderboxes destroy enemy siege equipment
Champions gain bonus points for kills in the keep
Three-way combat — any realm can attack any other

victory_conditions.albion: Survive 10 rounds with Caer Renaris under Albion control
victory_conditions.midgard: Capture Caer Renaris at any point

scenarios.name: Assault on Darkness Falls — The Demonic Dungeon
scenarios.description: The dominant realm enters Darkness Falls to challenge Legion and his demonic forces. But the other two realms can follow and attack inside the dungeon, turning the raid into a three-way battle.
scenarios.map: Darkness Falls — from the entrance wing to Legion's chamber

objective.dominant_realm: Defeat Legion and claim the loot before being pushed out.
objective.interlopers: Kill the dominant realm's players and seize control of the dungeon portals.

dominant_realm_forces: Full RvR group: tanks, healers, casters, and DPS
interloper_forces: Strike teams targeting healers and casters
Ambush groups at key choke points

special_rules: Only the dominant realm can enter initially
Interlopers can follow and attack inside
When portal control changes, the original realm can stay until they release on death
Healers can keep players alive to maintain access
Each realm has its own entrance and exit portals
Legion must be defeated for the dominant realm to win
RvR combat is fully active inside the dungeon

victory_conditions.dominant_realm: Defeat Legion and claim the loot
victory_conditions.interlopers: Seize portal control and eliminate the dominant realm's presence

scenarios.name: The Labyrinth of the Minotaur — Three-Way RvR Dungeon
scenarios.description: The largest RvR dungeon in DaOC history, located on Ellan Vannin Island. All three realms can access it simultaneously, making it the ultimate three-way battleground.
scenarios.map: Ellan Vannin — The Labyrinth of the Minotaur

objective.all_realms: Defeat the Labyrinth bosses, claim Mythrians, and earn Champion points.

all_realm_forces: Full RvR groups from each realm

special_rules: All three realms can enter simultaneously
Three-way combat throughout the dungeon
Mythrians are awarded for boss kills
Champion levels 6-10 can be progressed here
Ellan Vannin's central keep provides a staging area
Buggane's Obelisk rotates through the frontiers

victory_conditions.all_realms: Defeat the most bosses and claim the most Mythrians

scenarios.name: The Relic War — Capturing Enemy Relics
scenarios.description: Each realm's relics are located in heavily defended keeps. Capturing an enemy relic denies their bonuses and grants you theirs. This scenario simulates a coordinated assault on an enemy relic keep.
scenarios.map: Enemy frontier — the relic keep and its towers

objective.attacking_realm: Capture the enemy relic and hold it for 5 rounds.
objective.defending_realm: Defend the relic keep and prevent capture.
objective.third_realm: Capture the relic for yourself OR let the other two weaken each other.

attacking_forces: Full assault group: tanks, healers, casters, DPS
defending_forces: Keep garrison: tanks holding the capture point
third_realm_forces: Strike team ready to exploit weaknesses

special_rules: Relic keeps are heavily defended
Capturing the relic provides immediate realm bonuses
The third realm can opportunistically capture the relic
Siegecraft is essential for the assault
Champion points are awarded for relic captures
Relic bonuses can be viewed on the realm war map

victory_conditions.attacking_realm: Hold the enemy relic for 5 rounds

scenarios.name: Battle for Ellan Vannin — The Central Island
scenarios.description: Ellan Vannin is the central island connecting all three frontiers. With no keeps to capture, it's a pure open-combat zone with captureable docks and Buggane's Obelisk for solo RP bonuses.
scenarios.map: Ellan Vannin — the central island with docks and milegates

objective.all_realms: Control the docks, capture Buggane's Obelisk, and dominate the island.

all_realm_forces: Full RvR groups from each realm

special_rules: No keeps — pure open combat
Two captureable docks provide strategic value
Buggane's Obelisk grants RP bonus to solo players
Milegates per realm provide entry/exit points
Any realm can open the gates to the island
Central keep provides a neutral staging area

victory_conditions.all_realms: Control both docks and the most territory at the end of 10 rounds

scenarios.name: Tower Sweep — Clearing the Front Line
scenarios.description: Before a keep can be captured, its surrounding towers must be taken. This scenario focuses on the methodical process of 'towering out' — capturing all towers around an enemy keep to speed up the keep capture.
scenarios.map: Enemy frontier — a keep and its surrounding towers

objective.attacking_realm: Capture all towers around the enemy keep within 8 rounds.
objective.defending_realm: Defend at least one tower for 8 rounds.

attacking_forces: Tower capture squads: small groups for each tower
defending_forces: Tower defenders: small groups at each tower
Roving response team: reinforces threatened towers

special_rules: Each tower is captured independently
More towers captured = faster keep capture
Towers provide elevated positions for archers
Defenders can rove between towers
The third realm can capture towers opportunistically
Siege towers can help reach elevated capture points

victory_conditions.defending_realm: Hold at least one tower for 8 rounds

scenarios.name: Champion Rampage — Earning Champion Points
scenarios.description: A high-level Champion player goes on a killing spree in the Frontiers, earning Champion Points with each kill. The other realms must coordinate to stop the rampage.
scenarios.map: The Frontiers — any keep or tower zone

objective.champion: Earn 10 Champion Points by killing enemy players.
objective.hunters: Kill the Champion player and prevent further kills.

hunter_forces: Coordinated groups from both enemy realms
Tanks to taunt, casters to focus fire

special_rules: Champion gains abilities at each level
Champion Points are earned per kill
The Champion can port between friendly keeps
Hunters from both realms can cooperate
Champion auras buff nearby allies
If the Champion dies, they lose progress

victory_conditions.hunters: Kill the Champion before they reach 10 points

scenarios.name: Siege of Hadrian's Wall — Full Front Assault
scenarios.description: A full-scale assault on Albion's entire front line in Hadrian's Wall. Multiple keeps and towers are targeted simultaneously in a massive three-way battle.
scenarios.map: Hadrian's Wall — all keeps and towers

objective.albion: Defend at least 4 keeps for 15 rounds.

albion_forces: Full realm commitment: all available players
Tanks at each keep capture point
Healers and buffers distributed across the front
hibernia_forces: Full realm commitment: all available players
midgard_forces: Full realm commitment: all available players

special_rules: Multiple keeps are attacked simultaneously
Albion must divide forces across the front
Hibernia and Midgard can temporarily cooperate
But Hibernia and Midgard can also fight each other
Siegecraft is essential for both offense and defense
Champion points are awarded for all kills and captures
The realm with the most keeps gains Darkness Falls access
